title: (maintainability): centralize conflict-check package detail construction
observation: (maintainability): centralize conflict-check package detail construction `PackageDetails` is used by conflict-check code to keep a distribution version, its dependency requirements, and cached normalized dependency names together. After #14088, callers need to construct `PackageDetails` with both the raw dependency list and the derived normalized dependency-name list. That duplicates the construction pattern in production code and tests, and makes it easier for those fields to drift out of sync. This can be made easier to maintain by moving package-detail construction behind a small API on `PackageDetails` itself, so callers provide the version and dependency requirements while the normalized dependency names are derived in one place. This should be handled after #14088, since it builds on the cached dependency-name representation introduced there.
